race.title: Unibet's New VAR Goal Guarantee Fillies' Handicap
race.verdict: The return to this sort of trip will suit LUNELLA and unlike most of these, she has the scope to rate higher on what is just her second handicap start. Midnight Media can remain competitive, while Nottingham 1-2 Ghost Story and Glenna can also make their presence felt. LUNELLA (IRE) MIDNIGHT MEDIA GHOST STORY (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Midnight Media (3/1), Caraway (7/2), Ghost Story (4/1), Glenna (9/2), Albus Anne (6/1), Solar Pass (10/1), Moontune (10/1), Lucky Luna (14/1), Lunella (16/1), Just Queen High (25/1), Star Of Dubai (50/1), Vilaine Verlaine (66/1), Golden Phase (100/1), Musical Accord (100/1)
